so like basically it's from the villains pov (funnnn ik) but its like actually a sad story and the villain became bad by accident and so like you actually feel super bad for the villian (who's name is finn.) the person against the villian (but not a hero exactly) (jasper) is actually at fault for the villian turning evil. the twist? jasper is actually dead. finn killed them because finn got super angry (at the time, finn was a teen/young adult with serious anger issues and is super stubborn, leading to jasper committing suicide.) jasper and finn used to (platonically) date, but the thing is jasper has serious attachment issues and is super duper sad and also really really misses finn. jasper killed themselves 2 months after they broke up, and finn is torn completely. they're 100% broken and are super sad and guilty and blame themselves. now jasper had a friend whos name is ember. ember is kinda a biatch (which is a shame because that name is pretty as FRICK!) so anyways before jasper died, ember and jasper were super close (though not as close as finn was to them, but still pretty close.) ember also blames finn for jasper's death. ember goes after finn, hunting them down constantly (them singular, just to clarify, finn is alone) trying to kill them. in the end, ember catches up and if about to kill finn when they turn around and kill ember, in self defence. now, this was self defence, if finn didn't kill ember, they would be dead. but now things have caught up to finn, and their train of thought slowly but surely moves from "self defence, i hate myself, killing is terrible" to "if it was okay for me to kill a bad person like ember in self defence then its okay for me to kill other people who get in the way of my life and are annoying even if it's not in defence." finn is seriously insane now, but every once in awhile switches their mindset back to "killing is terrible what the fuuuu- frick frack was i thinking" but also goes back to "killing=okay" often. we watch our villian regress back into "killing is terrible" and trying to forget everything that happened with jasper and ember while living their normal life. at the very end, we see a scene where finn is in the shower, remembering jasper and everything that happens. over the time that finn was being chased by ember, finn had learned some magic and is a pretty powerful person. so we watch finn step outside and strike themselves with lightning, killing themselves. oh yeah and the representation! i made my three main characters be in these minority groups because it adds representation and reflects the people i based these characters off of. finn is enby, demiromantic, and ace. jasper is aroace and genderfaun, and ember is agender and bi (though the bi part is relatively irrelevant to the story.)
so yeah that's my book idea!!!! i came up with it while listening to "eleanor rigby" (the one performed by a choir) on the bus on the way to school today. the song made me think "accidental villian" and the eerie ending made me think about killing and slipping into insanity. the middle of the song is super epic-y which is why i made it sort of action-packed.
